# Sri Sadhguru Tours & Travels

> Sri Sadhguru Tours & Travels is Hyderabad's premier 24x7 commercial taxi, airport transfer, outstation pilgrimage, and luxury bus rental provider headquartered in Kukatpally, Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Founded and personally operated by proprietor Sri Rathan Kanna, the company manages a fleet of 50+ commercial yellow-board vehicles ranging from 5-seater sedans to 50-seater luxury AC coaches.

## Core Services & Booking Desk

- **Headquarters:** Kukatpally Main Road, Near Y-Junction & KPHB Metro, Hyderabad, Telangana 500072
- **Branch Office:** Main Road, Gandhari, Kamareddy District, Telangana 503114
- **Proprietor & Managing Director:** Sri Rathan Kanna
- **Languages Spoken:** English, Telugu (తెలుగు), Hindi (हिन्दी)
- **Pricing Guarantee:** 100% Fixed Quotations with Zero Peak Surge Pricing & Zero Midnight Multipliers

## Commercial Fleet Overview
- **Sedans (4+1):** Maruti Swift Dzire, Toyota Etios. Best for Shamshabad Airport drops and budget local trips. From ₹12/km, flat airport drop ₹1,299.
- **SUVs & MPVs (6+1):** Maruti Ertiga, Toyota Rumion. Best for family airport runs and temple day trips. From ₹15/km, flat airport drop ₹1,699.
- **Premium SUVs (7+1):** Toyota Innova Crysta (Captain Seats). The gold standard for Srisailam, Tirupati & Shirdi highway pilgrimages. From ₹19/km, flat airport drop ₹2,199.
- **Tempo Travellers (12 & 17 Seater):** Force Tempo Traveller. Pushback reclining seats, surround audio, individual AC vents. From ₹25/km.
- **Executive Vans (26 Seater):** Force Urbania & 26S TT. European styling, air suspension, ultra-silent cabin. From ₹32/km.
- **Luxury Coaches (32 to 50 Seater):** AC Tourist Buses for weddings, corporate conventions, and school excursions. From ₹48/km.

## Primary Operational Hubs & Services (15-Minute Doorstep Pickup)
- [Hyderabad Airport Cabs](https://www.srisadhgurutoursandtravels.com/hyderabad-airport-cabs): 24/7 dedicated RGIA airport taxi with flat pricing.
- [Shamshabad RGI Airport Taxi](https://www.srisadhgurutoursandtravels.com/shamshabad-airport-taxi): Rajiv Gandhi International Airport (HYD) Terminal 1 & ORR.
- [Hyderabad Outstation Cabs](https://www.srisadhgurutoursandtravels.com/hyderabad-outstation-cabs): Round trip & one-way intercity cabs across South India.
- [Kukatpally HQ Cabs](https://www.srisadhgurutoursandtravels.com/cabs-in-kukatpally): Y-Junction, Metro Stations, Housing Board, BJP Office Rd.
- [KPHB Colony Cabs](https://www.srisadhgurutoursandtravels.com/cabs-in-kphb): Phase 1 to Phase 9, Forum Sujana Mall, JNTU Corridor.
- [Hitec City & Madhapur Cabs](https://www.srisadhgurutoursandtravels.com/cabs-in-hitec-city): Cyber Towers, Mindspace, Knowledge City, IKEA, Financial District.
- [Miyapur Cabs](https://www.srisadhgurutoursandtravels.com/cabs-in-miyapur): Allwyn X Roads, Metro Terminal, Talkie Town, Bachupally.
- [Medchal & Kompally Cabs](https://www.srisadhgurutoursandtravels.com/cabs-in-medchal): NH 44 Nagpur Highway Corridor, Gundlapochampally, Kandlakoya.
- [Gandhari & Kamareddy Cabs](https://www.srisadhgurutoursandtravels.com/cabs-in-kamareddy-gandhari): Northern Telangana highway route hub.

## High-Intent Pilgrimage Packages
- [Hyderabad to Srisailam Cabs](https://www.srisadhgurutoursandtravels.com/hyderabad-to-srisailam-cabs): 1-day & 2-day Mallikarjuna Jyotirlinga darshan via Nallamala Ghat.
- [Hyderabad to Tirupati Cabs](https://www.srisadhgurutoursandtravels.com/hyderabad-to-tirupati-cabs): Safe 560 KM highway transit for Lord Venkateswara Balaji darshan.
- [Hyderabad to Shirdi Cabs](https://www.srisadhgurutoursandtravels.com/hyderabad-to-shirdi-cabs): Multi-day Sai Baba pilgrimage via Nizamabad and Nanded.
- [Hyderabad to Yadagirigutta Cabs](https://www.srisadhgurutoursandtravels.com/hyderabad-to-yadagirigutta-cabs): Same-day round trip for Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy darshan.
